title: Apple to launch news subscription service: Bloomberg
text:
Published: Apr 17, 2018 8:34 a.m. ET Share 
By Emily Bary 
Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.86% intends to launch a news-subscription service following its acquisition of magazine-subscription app Texture, according to Bloomberg . The premium service will be housed in the Apple News app, the Bloomberg report said, and is expected to launch within a year. Apple will give some of the revenue it makes from the service to magazine publishers, Bloomberg said. The news-subscription service would play into Apple's goal of growing its services business, which is currently consists of revenue from the App store, Apple Pay, Apple Music, and other non-hardware sources. Shares of Apple are up 0.6% in premarket trading and up 24% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.03% of which Apple is a component, has gained 19% in that time.
